notes.title: Bygone Dreams - Exclusive Steam Next Fest showcase
notes.content:
Tune in and check out Bygone Dreams extended game showcase. 
First part of the game made exclusively for Steam Next Fest!

Bygone Dreams is a high fantasy action adventure with RPG elements set in a surreal dream world.

The dream land of Lume, under the protection of its matron deity, is being threatened by a terrible Nightmare. Embodying the spirit known as Wa, you are the world's last hope for survival.
To aid you in your quest, you must seek out the world's Guardians - powerful creatures worshiped and revered in times long before the corruption seeped in. However, the task ahead is anything but easy, as the Guardians themselves succumbed to the Nightmare.

FEATURES:
- Explore the dream-land of Lume, a vast world full of mystery and danger.
- Face dozens of epic bosses standing in the way between you and the salvation of the Dream.
- Fight your way through the game using a combination of melee weapons, ranged weapons, and magic. Customize your equipment to suit your play style.
- Experience the story on Normal difficulty or get ready for an exceptional challenge on Heroic mode - a ramped up difficulty featuring revamped boss fights and additional Heroic-only bosses.
- Unlock handcrafted higher difficulty levels.
- Experience the epic story with over 2 hours of fully voiced cutscenes.
- Show your mastery in special time trial and no damage boss challenges.

The game will take players on an inspirational adventure featuring elements from Slavic mythology and medieval Bosnian folklore. An epic orchestral soundtrack will set the tone of the journey in over 50 original songs full of traditional instruments and melodies.
Take a leap into the world of Bygone Dreams and prepare yourself for an unforgettable experience!

[i]Note: Event is pre-recorded![/i]

notes.title: Bygone Dreams - Characters
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Meet the colorful characters who bring the game's story to life! Each character has a unique personality and motivation that drives the plot. Our talented writers and artists have created rich and sophisticated characters that you will want to interact with. 

There are 20 characters in the game, as well as over 50 different types of enemies for players to discover.

[b]Wa[/b] - The main character of the game. Once a powerful Huma spirit, Wa is a being born of empathy.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/041/814/140/fa6a3786dbaea30301b450945dbbb897_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=680&fit=max&v=1690962571&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=5944847791c96718bbb9c87c111c7d75[/img]

[b]Aelona[/b]- The matron deity of the game. She creates and nurtures the dream and all creatures within.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/041/814/161/46972e4b8cd0a1a92e89b8552748bfb4_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=680&fit=max&v=1690962811&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=d1795d2823e08bd1438d412245b0ddfd[/img]

[b]Acaulis[/b] - The Guardian of Nature can read to the ebb and flow of the Dream. His realm is connected to all flora and through it he hears and sees all. 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/041/814/241/c837e5a9a7e6f54aedff21d1242f1d70_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=680&fit=max&v=1690963562&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=79dea66362e9d0e72e7303aea8640dba[/img]

[b]Gnomon[/b] - A powerful alchemist, Gnomon was one of the first beings to sense that something was wrong with the Allmother.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/041/814/327/354a575d1f72015c3088a87defd72538_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=680&fit=max&v=1690964391&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=aa2f45ca859604c4b2c0eb7142d443e0[/img]

[b]Savarog[/b] - A mechanical construct with a biological heart at its core, Savarog was once called The Builder. 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/041/814/337/d067dadcb2caf7621f80afe5c663c00c_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=680&fit=max&v=1690964599&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=70609e6a9352b86cd41755c5d08bfd70[/img]

[b]Libra[/b] - The Guardian of Wisdom has been granted the gift of sight, seeing the past and the future of the Dream written in the pages of his infinite library. The burden of knowledge however has strained his sanity to its breaking point.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/041/814/786/b5d3084779f7fbb9ad569bc0b37bc1c9_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=680&fit=max&v=1690967909&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=a445b253956674d2a7617d40f81344d4[/img]

[b]Agni[/b] - The Guardian of Flame is the middle of the three elemental sisters. Her power is only matched by her temper

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/041/814/797/89b31131497ae2aa73d3948eddffd30a_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=680&fit=max&v=1690968027&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=6c9fe8613589d9b770cf0b66786ba541[/img]

[b]Miyabi[/b] - The blind Guardian of Art turned his pursuit of beauty into a neverending obsession, expanding his museum with everything he could find, including Wa.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/041/814/812/50d21d74185ff8a4c3133e4e9ea2a4fa_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=680&fit=max&v=1690968166&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=17b0b288db63c4c94f84b8e945c10507[/img]

[b]Nycto[/b] - The Guardian of Uncertain Dawn is a mysterious being following in Wa’s footsteps.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/041/814/831/baf9ec08b71d748d515aa38dde333d37_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=680&fit=max&v=1690968338&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=cd742f3feca15d0a90548300eda795c0[/img]

Stay tuned, we'll reveal enemies as well very soon!

notes.title: The World of Lume
notes.content:
The world is an interconnected, living ecosystem, with numerous hidden nooks and crannies for players to explore.

Lume's world will leave you with memories that will last a lifetime, whether you're exploring the wide and intriguing landscapes, fighting epic battles with powerful adversaries, or simply taking in the breathtaking sights and sounds.

Be ready to disappear into a unique world of dreams!
